While the investigation steps were methodical and on the right track - extracting errors, identifying codes, finding TFM associations - the agent was too slow and never reached the synthesis/reporting phase. The task explicitly requested a structured report with (1) error summary, (2) root-cause grouping with evidence, (3) verified fix, and none of these were delivered.
